Subject: Massey University Survey of Student Satisfaction with Services

Subject


 





 
 
 
 




 

Dear Tony  
 
Recently we invited you to participate in the major annual survey of student satisfaction with services at Massey University. 

 
Your views are very important to us. If you have not yet had the chance to complete the survey, may we urge you to do so without delay. The survey closes on the 4th of May . 

 
Please click on the link below to gain access to the survey. 

 START THE SURVEY
 
 
Thank you for taking the time to give us your response. Your participation in this survey is very much appreciated.  
 
 
 For assistance at any time while completing the questionnaire please email ssurvey@massey.ac.nz or phone 0800 MASSEY (or +64 6 350 5701 if outside NZ) or contact the survey provider MMResearchTM on 0800 667373 (or +64 4 587 0500 if outside NZ).


 
Yours sincerely

Theo Muller
Managing Director 
MMResearchTM
 

Dr Patrick Sandbrook
Director National Student Relations
Massey University
 
This project has been reviewed and approved by the Massey University Human Ethics Committee: Southern B, Application 06/53. If you have any concerns about the conduct of this research, please contact Dr Karl Pajo, Chair, Massey University Human Ethics Committee: Southern B, telephone 04 801 5799 x 6929, email humattgvanjkniol@massey.ac.nz
